answer_1.quote: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) produces a long-form answer to a query using a set of relevant input passages... PROPCITE, a post-hoc methodology that adds citations to the input context supporting propositions (atomic facts) in the generated text.

answer_2.quote: Citation precision assesses if the output is completely supported by cited passages, while citation recall identifies irrelevant citations... PROPCITE enhances citation quality across both 4B and 7B model outputs.

answer_3.quote: These metrics are calculated with TRUE, an 11B-parameter model trained on a collection of natural language inference datasets, and widely used for evaluating whether cited passages entail the claims in the sentence.
